text: Dockentra WMS gives your brand its own client portal.
Send a new order in a few taps. It goes straight to the warehouse.
Every shipment shows its status, right up to the courier handover.
Charges are logged as the work is done, and you can see this month's estimate at any time.
On the floor, every pick is scanned.
The software is built and tested, and our warehouse is opening in Limerick.
Dockentra. Fulfilment for small sellers, powered by software we built ourselves.
